Game Overview

In Blend Fruits, the core idea is straightforward: merge and grow fruity combos in Blend Fruits, a strategic puzzle adventure. Keep your board tidy as you blend identical fruits, unlocking rare combos and using powerful boosters. Challenge yourself to reach high scores, creating a juicy, ever-evolving puzzle experience perfect for players of all skill levels.
